notes_for_editor: The tower's build date, builder, height, owner and access are not in any source read. The memorial page spells the name 'Springsted' once; the Forest Lookouts and firelookout.org lists use 'Springstead'. The National Register nomination covers the Springstead cabin complex and does not mention the tower. The memorial page's dates for Pripps's service are absent. No WHS tower record was found. The DNR closure in 2015 is statewide; the sources do not say whether this tower was included.
